notes: v2.0.1 — Bug fixes. Stopped a stationary phone from auto-answering incoming calls: the ring volume-up watcher now only reacts to changes on the RING stream (and confirms the call is still ringing), so notification, media or system volume changes can no longer be misread as an answer gesture. Added a clear (X) button to the Contacts search field and the merge-contact picker so the search text can be cleared in one tap.
